name: Samson Hastings
source:
A very shy person. He always loks like he's nervous. I haven't spent too much time talking to Samson, but he seems nice. He's had a huge crush on Lily for a very long time.

Samson wears an orange ribbon on his left wrist, a black ring on the middle finger of his right hand, and has a piercing in his left ear.

[From Idril's Phone Contacts In-Game]
